# organization type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:organizationType`](gmeow-organizationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/organizationType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

The kind(s) of an organization (one or more [`gmeow:OrganizationType`](../classes/gmeow-OrganizationType.md) individuals). Non-functional: a single organization may be both a company and an educational institution, and competing classifications coexist as standpoint-indexed claims ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
